speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease

The pain is localized to the left knee, but in children, hip pathology often refers pain to the knee. I need to check for internal hip rotation and abduction limitations. Please have the child lie down and attempt to cross their left leg over their right knee; does this cause pain? REQUEST TEST: HXK (Hip X-Ray AP and Lateral).
